properties.name: llm4s.enabled
properties.description: Whether the LLM4S auto-configuration is active. Set to false to switch off the JLlmClient, LLM4STemplate and health indicator beans without excluding the starter.

properties.name: llm4s.provider
properties.description: LLM provider to use. Supported: openai, anthropic, ollama. Required.

properties.name: llm4s.model
properties.description: Model name passed to the provider, for example gpt-4o. Required.

properties.name: llm4s.api-key
properties.description: API key for the provider. Required for openai and anthropic; never logged.

properties.name: llm4s.base-url
properties.description: Override the provider's base URL. Defaults: openai https://api.openai.com/v1, anthropic https://api.anthropic.com, ollama http://localhost:11434.

properties.name: llm4s.context-window
properties.description: Total token capacity of the model (prompt plus completion). Must be positive.

properties.name: llm4s.reserve-completion
properties.description: Tokens held back from the prompt for the completion. Must be non-negative and smaller than llm4s.context-window.

properties.name: llm4s.async.max-threads
properties.description: Maximum worker threads of the default llm4sTaskExecutor bean (idle threads time out). Define your own bean named llm4sTaskExecutor to replace the executor. Must be at least 1.

properties.name: llm4s.async.queue-capacity
properties.description: Queued completeAsync calls the default executor accepts before rejecting new ones (the returned future then fails). Must be at least 1.

properties.name: llm4s.health.probe
properties.description: Make the health indicator send a one-token completion to the provider. Off by default because it is a billed call; when off the indicator reports probe=disabled and only that the client is configured.

properties.name: llm4s.health.probe-ttl
properties.description: How long a probe result is reused, so frequent health polling does not call the provider each time. Must not be negative.

properties.name: llm4s.health.probe-timeout
properties.description: A probe taking longer than this is cancelled (interrupting the provider call) and reports DOWN. Must be positive.
